exposure: other barriers to obtaining postpartum sterilization
outcome: receipt of interval sterilization by 3 months postpartum
cohort: Women who gave birth over an 8-month period and requested immediate postpartum sterilization.
finding: A significant proportion of women requesting postpartum sterilization had unfulfilled requests primarily due to Medicaid consent issues, leading to a low likelihood of receiving interval sterilization by 3 months postpartum.
